data.name: Check-up and clean
data.summary: We look at your teeth and gums, take X-rays if they are due, and polish away the stains.

data.name: Hygienist visit
data.summary: A deep clean below the gum line, with advice on brushing that suits your mouth.

data.name: White filling
data.summary: A tooth-coloured filling for a cavity or a chipped edge, matched to the shade of your teeth.

data.name: Emergency appointment
data.summary: Toothache, a broken tooth or a lost filling: we keep time free every day for pain.

data.name: Teeth whitening
data.summary: Two visits to fit your trays, then two weeks of whitening at home.

data.name: Children's check-up
data.summary: For patients under 18, with a dentist who takes it slowly. No charge.
